mentions.name: poemd
mentions.description: This app is an online markdown scratchpad that supports GitHub Flavoured Markdown and stores all data in the URL, so there are no accounts and documents persist in bookmarks. The URL-based storage also makes documents somewhat shareable, though Open Graph previews render inconsistently (e.g., Messenger shows the long encoded URL).
mentions.source_excerpt: I made https://poemd.dev/ as an online markdown scratchpad that supports GitHub Flavoured Markdown and stores all data in the URL. This means there are no accounts to work with and everything is basically stored in bookmarks if you choose to.
